title: Bound turn file-change summaries across successive watcher generations
outcome: Design and validate a separate bound on the accumulation of distinct paths in turn file-change summaries, preserving truthful coverage and named-root attribution.
acceptance: A documented policy bounds retained turn-summary storage across successive watcher flushes while preserving exact paths or truthful covering markers for every accumulated change.
Focused tests exercise distinct workdir and named source root, repeated flushes, late summaries and unrelated-root isolation; the implemented input passes the required review and gates.
